Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer

Class FlightComputerControllerPlots

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer.FlightComputerControllerPlots
public final class FlightComputerControllerPlots extends Object
Self-describing, stable per-block channels. Unit codes are saved in symbols for standalone log/result import.
